messages:
DeployBot: Automated publish to eu-ecr for repo `infra/my-service` failed provenance check -> manifest missing platform annotation. Holding publish and marking canary as failed. :warning:

Alex: ugh. which step failed — cosign attestation or deploybot manifest validation?

DeployBot: cosign attestation returned OK, but our provenance linter flagged `manifest.platform` absent. Error snippet: `manifest validation: missing fields: [os, architecture]` (push accepted by registry, but publish blocked).

Maya: This was a canary-only push right? Any user-facing rollout yet?

DeployBot: only staging-canary pool (3 replicas). No production pins changed.

Sam: ok let's not push a retag blindly. Plan: pin the service in k8s to the previous verified digest and keep traffic on the older canary until infra confirms manifest shape. e.g. `image: ghcr.io/redwood/infra-my-service@sha256:prevdeadbeef`

Reena: filing the release note entry: "canary publish held due to missing platform metadata in manifest; no prod impact; manual republish scheduled." Will add to notes and mention customers impacted if any.

Priya: propose change window tonight 02:00 UTC for manual republish + cosign re-verify. If infra confirms it's safe we can republish with corrected manifest and re-run canaries. If not, rollback release candidate and open follow-up.

Maya: quick diagnostic commands I ran: `aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name infra/my-service --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:abcd1234 --output json` -> returned manifest without `os`/`architecture`. Also cross-account mirror shows platform annotation present upstream. Seems our mirror/manifestlist builder is stripping platform entries when squashing multi-arch into single manifest.

Sam: potential root cause: manifestlist -> single-manifest conversion step in deploybot image optimizer. If it loses platform metadata, our provenance linter flags it. We should avoid the conversion for images that already have cosign attestations.

Alex: immediate actionable decisions?

Priya: decided: 1) Hold current publish (already done). 2) Pin k8s canary to previous digest (Sam). 3) Schedule manual republish in change window 02:00 UTC (Priya + Reena). 4) Eng-infra to investigate and patch manifestlist converter to preserve platform annotations (Maya). 5) Add a short rollback criteria to release notes: if canary error-rate > 1% or latency p50 doubles within 30m, revert to previous image.

DeployBot: I will annotate the release object with `publish:held` and note assignees: Sam, Maya.

OnCallBot: Escalating to #eng-infra and #eng-runtime for visibility.

Reena: PR created for release notes + checklist: https://git.internal/redwood/releases/pulls/732 (will add manual republish steps and cosign reverify checklist).

Maya: I'll start a debug run against the mirror builder and paste logs here shortly.

Alex: thanks all. keeping this thread open until manual republish completes. if anyone needs a heads up, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
